title: A pending item's continuation stamp carries absolute host paths (the operator's account name) into tracked inbox files
summary: continuation.RedactHostPaths collapses the home directory to ~ for released bindings, because consumed items are tracked and ride commits to the public remote (audit cycle-1507 M1). The pending item's own `continuation` stamp, written when a failed lane's work is preserved, is not redacted: origin/main already holds pending items whose continuation.worktree and findings_path are /Users/<account>/... paths, and every wave boundary lands more (2026-09-29: the stamps from cycles 1761 and 1762).
fix: Redact the stamp the mover writes into the tracked item (worktree and findings_path to the ~ form, the same RedactHostPaths), and make every reader of findings_path expand ~ before opening it. The registry, which is host runtime state, keeps absolute paths.
acceptance: A failed lane's preserved item, as written to the tracked inbox file, contains no absolute home path (red today)
The next builder still reads the finding through the redacted findings_path
